liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **The Last Thing On My Mind** (1 other source): Played as a tribute to Dolly Parton, who died on August 25th, 2026, with Lindsay Lou on vocals and Mark Lavengood on dobro [1]
- **Seven Weeks In County** (1 other source): Includes a tease of Ennio Morricone's "The Good, The Bad, & The Ugly" [2]
- **Carry Us Home** (1 other source): Billy Strings and Jarrod Walker played it as a duo, with Jarrod on guitar [2]

## Setlist highlights

- **SET 1 02 I’m One Of Those**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [6]
- **SET 1 03 Burn The Other End**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [6]
- **SET 1 04 Carry Us Home (1)**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [6]
- **SET 1 05 Lay Me Down**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [6]
- **SET 1 06 Lucid Daydream**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [6]
- **SET 1 07 Mill Town Flood2**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [6]
- **SET 1 08 Live To Tell (2,3)**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [6]
- **SET 1 09 Bluewater Breakdown**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [6]

## The recordings

- **billystrings2026-08-28** (recommended): source not stated; 29 songs; 199 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]
- **billystrings2026-08-28.BMFS**: source not stated; 29 songs; 187 min [2]
- **Billy2026-08-28**: source not stated; 29 songs; 187 min [3]
- **BMFS2026-08-28**: source not stated; 16 songs; 187 min [4]

## Around the show

- The Last Thing On My Mind was last played on 2020-02-27, a gap of 524 shows [1]

## Tapers and lineage

- **billystrings2026-08-28**: taped by JB; source: AKG 414 [1]
- **billystrings2026-08-28.BMFS**: taped by Tony DeStefanis; source: Schoeps mk22 > nbobs > mixpre6ii [2]. Also: Schoeps mk22 microphones into nbobs, then a Mixpre6ii recorder, edited in Audacity, converted with CDWE, and tagged with TLH as FLAC8 [2]
- **Billy2026-08-28**: taped by Tony DeStefanis; source: Schoeps mk41 (DINa) > nbobs > mixpre6ii [3]. Also: Schoeps mk41 microphones, DINa configuration, into nbobs, then a Mixpre6ii recorder, Audacity, CDWE and TLH, as FLAC8 [3]
- **BMFS2026-08-28**: taped by Tony DeStefanis; source: Schoeps mk22 > nbobs > mixpre6ii [4]
